Stratify xylem spots

```{r stratify xylem spots}
n_sector <- 20
n_layer <- 4

# Run after the existing pith/phloem spot exclusions.
xy <- as.data.frame(
    GetTissueCoordinates(sp_xylem)[Cells(sp_xylem), 1:2]
)
colnames(xy) <- c("x", "y")
xy$barcode <- rownames(xy)

# Approximate center of the stem; verify against the histology.
center <- colMeans(xy[, c("x", "y")])

xy$r <- sqrt((xy$x - center[1])^2 +
             (xy$y - center[2])^2)
xy$theta <- (atan2(xy$y - center[2],
                   xy$x - center[1]) + 2*pi) %% (2*pi)
xy$sector <- floor(xy$theta / (2*pi/ n_sector)) + 1L

# Three radial bands within each angular sector.
xy <- xy %>%
    group_by(sector) %>%
    mutate(
        depth = (quantile(r, .95) - r) /
                (quantile(r, .95) - quantile(r, .05)),
        radial_layer = as.integer(
            pmin(n_layer, pmax(1, floor(n_layer * depth) + 1))
        )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

sp_xylem$radial_layer <- xy$radial_layer[
    match(Cells(sp_xylem), xy$barcode)
]

p <- SpatialDimPlot(
    sp_xylem,
    group.by = "radial_layer",
    crop = FALSE,
    pt.size.factor = .7
) +
  # scale_fill_manual(
  #   values = c("#9E0059", "#30638E", "#FF8811")
  # ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p

dirout_tmp <- file.path("outputs/notebook/Spatial/Revision")
dir.create(dirout_tmp)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
        dirout_tmp, "subplot_D.png"
    ),
    width=10,
    height=8
)
```

```{r}
# Original counts and SCT residuals
raw <- GetAssayData(sp_xylem, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")
sct <- GetAssayData(sp_xylem, assay = "SCT", layer = "scale.data")

# Same genes and spots across comparisons
spots <- Cells(sp_xylem)
genes <- intersect(rownames(raw), rownames(sct))
raw <- raw[genes, spots, drop = FALSE]
sct <- sct[genes, spots, drop = FALSE]

# Normalize using each spot's total counts across ALL genes
totals <- Matrix::colSums(
    GetAssayData(sp_xylem, assay = "Spatial", layer = "counts")[, spots]
)
logcpm <- log1p(raw %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = 1e4 / totals))

# Within-layer mean gene variance
layer <- sp_xylem$radial_layer
calc <- function(X) {
    sapply(1:n_layer, function(k) {
        mean(apply(
            as.matrix(X[, which(layer == k), drop = FALSE]),
            1, var
        ))
    })
}

V <- rbind(
    raw_counts = calc(raw),
    logCPM = calc(logcpm),
    SCT_residuals = calc(sct)
)
V
```

```{r}
# Calculate variation
colnames(V) <- c("Cambium", "Outer", "Middle", "Inner")

# Convert to long format; normalize each method to its outer layer
df <- as.data.frame(as.table(V))
colnames(df) <- c("method", "layer", "variance")

df <- df %>%
    group_by(method) %>%
    mutate(relative = 100 * variance / variance[layer == "Cambium"]) %>%
    ungroup()

# Plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(layer, relative, color = method, group = method)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
        raw_counts = "#E67D74",
        logCPM = "#1EAA78",
        SCT_residuals = "#6697E8"
    )) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
    labs(
        title = "Transcriptomic heterogeneity across xylem layers",
        subtitle = sprintf("%d sectors · %d radial layers · 3,000 HVGs", n_sector, n_layer),
        x = "Radial layer (cambium side → pith side)",
        y = "Variance relative to outer layer",
        color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom"
    )
print(p)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(dirout_tmp, "transcriptomic_heterogeneity.png"),
  width=6,
  height=4
)
```

# Integrate single-cell & spatial data (deconvolution)

```{r}
# remove outlier cells
valid_cells <- rownames(sc_data@meta.data)[!is.na(sc_data$cell_label)]
sc_data <- subset(sc_data, cells = valid_cells)
counts <- sc_data[["RNA"]]$counts
sc_data$cluster <- sc_data$cell_label
cluster <- as.factor(sc_data$cluster)
nUMI <- sc_data$nCount_RNA
levels(cluster) <- gsub("/", "-", levels(cluster))
cluster <- droplevels(cluster)

# create the RCTD reference object
reference <- Reference(counts, cluster, nUMI)

counts_hd <- sp_xylem[["Spatial"]]$counts
xylem_cells_hd <- colnames(sp_xylem[["Spatial"]])
coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(sp_xylem)[xylem_cells_hd, 1:2]

# create the RCTD query object
query <- SpatialRNA(coords, counts_hd, colSums(counts_hd))
```

```{r}
# run RCTD
RCTD <- create.RCTD(query, reference, max_cores = 18)
RCTD <- run.RCTD(RCTD, doublet_mode = "full")
# add results back to Seurat object
sp_xylem <- AddMetaData(sp_xylem, metadata = RCTD@results$results_df)
```

```{r}
# Obtain full-mode cell-type weights from the original spacexr RCTD
W <- as.matrix(
    spacexr::normalize_weights(RCTD@results$weights)
)

spots <- Cells(sp_xylem)
W <- W[spots, , drop = FALSE]

# Mean estimated cell-type proportions across radial layers
cell_type_proportion <- aggregate(
    W,
    by = list(layer = sp_xylem$radial_layer),
    FUN = mean
)
p_proportion <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cell_type_proportion %>% select(-layer),
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE, 
  main = "RCTD weights"
)
p_proportion
save_fig(
  p_proportion,
  file.path(dirout_tmp, "RCTD.svg"),
  width = 7,
  height = 4
)
```

Find the nearest single-cell data point to each spatial data point

```{r}
dist_on_integrated_reduc <- dist(Embeddings(merged, reduction = "integrated.cca"))
dist_on_integrated_reduc <- as.matrix(dist_on_integrated_reduc)
dist_on_integrated_reduc <- dist_on_integrated_reduc[Cells(sp_xylem), Cells(sc_data)]
nearest_sc_cell_to_sp_xylem <- apply(dist_on_integrated_reduc, 1, function(x)(names(which.min(x))))
sc_annotated_sp_xylem <- paste("sp", merged@meta.data[nearest_sc_cell_to_sp_xylem, "cluster"], sep = "-")
merged@meta.data[Cells(sp_xylem), "cluster"] <- sc_annotated_sp_xylem
```

# Give biological meanings to spatial data

Spatial data and single-cell data are poorly integrated. We doubt
whether data from these to technologies can be integrated. Instead of
trying to integrate the two datasets, we now focus on spatial
transcriptome data itself. We will inspect the expression level of wood
formation related genes across the cross-section and see whether it
captures process of wood formation.

Continued from ![Record clustering
results](##%20Record%20clustering%20results)

```{r}
    comment.char = ""
)
annot_info
```

## Monolignol biosynthesis genes (according to <https://www.genome.jp/kegg/tables>)

(K10775,K13064) K00487 K01904 K13065 K09754 K00588 K09753 K09755 K13066
(K00083,K22395)

```{r}
ko_list <- c(
    "K10775", "K13064", "K00487", "K01904", "K13065", 
    "K09754", "K00588", "K09753", "K09755", "K13066", 
    "K00083", "K22395"
)
gene_list <- unlist(sapply(
    ko_list, function(x) {
        subset(annot_info, grepl(x, annot_info$KO))$locusName
    }
))
gene_list <- paste(gene_list, ".v4.1", sep = "")
gene_list_pruned <- gene_list[gene_list %in% Features(sp_xylem)]
length(gene_list_pruned)
dir.create("outputs/notebook/Spatial/FeaturePlots/")
# plot
length(gene_list_pruned)
p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(sp_xylem, slot = "counts", features = gene_list_pruned, ncol = 5)
ggsave(
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/FeaturePlot_M00039_counts.png",
    width = 20,
    height = 12
)
```

Two genes: Potri.001G304800 & Potri.009G099800 show similar patter of
higher -\> low from early -\> late. Best hit in Arabidopsis: AT4G34050
We check the expression level in AspWood data. The genes in P. tremula

## Plot expression level of DEGs

### Mid vs. Early

```{r}
DEA_mid_vs_early <- FindMarkers(sp_xylem, ident.1 = "mid", ident.2 = "early", test.use = "wilcox")
cat("Found N DEG:", sum(DEA_mid_vs_early$p_val_adj < 0.05))
p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    sp_xylem, 
    slot = "data", 
    features = rownames(DEA_mid_vs_early[DEA_mid_vs_early$p_val_adj < 0.05, ][1:15, ]), 
    ncol = 5
)
ggsave(
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/FeaturePlot_DEA_mid_vs_early_top15.png",
    width = 20,
    height = 12
)
```

Export DEA data.frame

```{r}
DEA_table <- DEA_mid_vs_early
DEA_table$best_arabi_gene <- ""
for (i in 1:nrow(DEA_table)) {
    ptr_gene <- substr(rownames(DEA_table[i, ]), 1, 16)
    ath_gene <- subset(annot_info, annot_info$locusName == ptr_gene)$best_arabi_gene[1]
    if (length(ath_gene) != 0) {
        DEA_table[i, "best_arabi_gene"] <- ath_gene
    }
}
write.csv(
    DEA_table,
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/DEA_mid_vs_early.csv"
)
cat(subset(DEA_table, (DEA_table$p_val_adj < 0.05) & (DEA_table$avg_log2FC > 0))$best_arabi_gene, sep = "\n")
```

### Mid vs. Early & Late

```{r}
DEA_all <- FindAllMarkers(sp_xylem,  test.use = "wilcox")
cat(
    "Found N DEG:", sum((DEA_all$cluster == "mid") & (DEA_all$p_val_adj < 0.05))
)
p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    sp_xylem, 
    slot = "data", 
    features = rownames(DEA_all[(DEA_all$cluster == "mid") & (DEA_all$p_val_adj < 0.05),]), 
    ncol = 5
)
ggsave(
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/FeaturePlot_DEA_mid_vs_all_top10.png",
    width = 20,
    height = 8
)

# export DEA data.frame
DEA_table <- DEA_all
DEA_table$best_arabi_gene <- ""
for (i in 1:nrow(DEA_table)) {
    ptr_gene <- substr(rownames(DEA_table[i, ]), 1, 16)
    ath_gene <- subset(annot_info, annot_info$locusName == ptr_gene)$best_arabi_gene[1]
    if (length(ath_gene) != 0) {
        DEA_table[i, "best_arabi_gene"] <- ath_gene
    }
}
write.csv(
    DEA_table,
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/DEA_mid_vs_all.csv"
)
subset(DEA_table, (DEA_table$p_val_adj < 0.05) & (DEA_table$cluster == "mid") & (DEA_table$avg_log2FC > 0))
```
